name: Melia Orlando Celebration
insider_take: This upscale resort sits in the heart of Celebration, Walt Disney World's picture-perfect planned community, offering a sophisticated escape just minutes from the magic.
whats_special: Located in Disney's charming town of Celebration, this Mediterranean-inspired resort features a stunning lagoon-style pool with waterslides and sits on a championship golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr. The hotel's prime location puts you within walking distance of Celebration's quaint downtown area, filled with boutique shops and waterfront dining.
pro_tip: Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle service to Disney parks, but also explore Celebration on foot – the town's tree-lined streets and lakefront promenade offer a peaceful contrast to the theme park excitement.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Celebration Golf Course offers breathtaking views of pristine wetlands and challenging play for all skill levels. End your day at the rooftop bar overlooking the sparkling lights of Celebration and distant Disney fireworks on clear evenings.
pros: Prime location near Disney World and theme parks
Multiple dining options and rooftop bar with views
cons: Premium pricing during peak Disney seasons
